publisher_assessment.decision: Accept 48 official links within their recorded scope and 33 local copies after separate review. One superseded IBZ route is not relied upon. No legal topic is accepted as adequately covered; Belgium review remains incomplete.
publisher_assessment.basis: Accepted local copies have separate evidence for publisher identity, version/freshness limits, extraction completeness or native-file integrity, attachment scope and legal classification. Exact raw capture hashes were verified where retained; the current Codex source is a newly captured publisher response. Dynamic guidance and process pages retain date and scope caveats. External-link acceptance, local-copy acceptance and topic coverage remain separate. The Federal Justice adoption-abroad article was reviewed as a dated official guidance snapshot through its accessible www.justice.belgium.be route; it has no displayed update date and remains related guidance only. The Federal Justice guidance and the French APD complaint page have dated local snapshots accepted within recorded limits. Direct APD access returned maintenance text on 2026-10-24, so its currentness remains unresolved. The EU-family overview candidate was reopened on 2026-10-29. Although the overview remains incomplete, its linked detailed page for third-country family members was readable enough for an independently written, tightly scoped maintained source note; the separate page for family members who are themselves EU citizens was not retrieved. The French Justel consolidation of the 1991 population-register and residence-document law was retained after current-page extraction, amendment comparison, rights review and attribution. The Legalize BE candidate is kept as the retrieval trail, while the accepted text is rebuilt from the current official Justel page.
publisher_assessment.limitation: Acceptance of official links and the accepted local source texts does not establish legal topic completeness, validate every linked form or case, or mark Belgium review complete. The Ostbelgien legal database expressly warns that only the original Gazette publication is legally binding. The be-eu-family-guidance note covers only readable linked guidance for third-country family members; the overview remains incomplete and the separate EU-citizen-family page could not be retrieved.

policy: A trustworthy official government consolidated text or clearly identified official page may be accepted as an external reference within its displayed status, version, language, date and subject. If authority, version or content is unclear, offer the whole official government website/service for human review. A human-reviewed link is sufficient for ordinary source use; a local copy, custom retrieval/conversion rule, API, full Gazette amendment chain, hash, replay or scheduled update is not a blanket prerequisite. External-link acceptance is separate from local-copy acceptance, issue/topic coverage and country review completion.
